source: Minchat Shai on Gen 7:2 (Ramah; corrected Masorah)
claim_en: הטהורה ("the pure one," with the article) — the Ramah: plene with vav exactly TWICE in the Torah, "both verse-openings" — the boarding commands 7:2 and 7:8; every other pure-form defective (Minchat Shai calls our printed Masorah here "words of error"). SNAPSHOT holds THREE plene tokens: the Ramah's verse-initial pair AND 8:20 (the altar verse) — the third is a deviation from his rule, banked as a discrepancy for the gen_20 audit. (The pure LAMPSTAND's tokens and Lev 20:25, same pronunciation, are all defective — consistent with the rule.)

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 7:8 (Pesachim 3a; Bereshit Rabbah 32)
claim_en: DISCREPANCY OBSERVATION, the tradition's own — the Talmud: "the verse BENT EIGHT LETTERS rather than utter an ugly word" (אשר איננה טהרה, "which is not pure," for הטמאה, "the impure"). Minchat Shai's challenge: טהרה here is written DEFECTIVE (four letters), so the detour is SEVEN letters, not eight — and he resolves it by Bereshit Rabbah's version, which counts WORDS ("two and three words"), not letters. SNAPSHOT sides with his arithmetic: the defective spelling locked.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 7:11 (Hilleli vs Yerushalmi; Ramah; Or Torah)
claim_en: DISCREPANCY OBSERVATION — מעינות ("fountains"): "a great dispute on this word." The Hilleli codex, the Ramah, and Or Torah rule 7:11 PLENE — "full when the fountains were full" — and 8:2's closing token defective, "drained when they drained": the spelling-homily rides the ruling. SNAPSHOT writes BOTH tokens defective (מעינת) — the Yerushalmi camp — against the Ramah's ruling and its homily. Both camps recorded; the check locks zero plene tokens.

היקום ("the standing-substance") — the Kitzur's Masorah trio, all THREE in the Torah: "and I will wipe out all the standing" (7:4), "and He wiped out all the standing" (7:23), "and all the standing at their feet" (Deut 11:6 — Korach's household): "as the flood generation sinned from too much good, so Korach from his wealth." SNAPSHOT: exactly three tokens.

והבאים ("and those coming") — the Kitzur's Masorah pair spans out of the Torah: the boarding animals (7:16) and "those who came with Zerubbabel" (the return list): "as here they came OF THEMSELVES, so there they went up of themselves." Torah-side: this is the word's only token — and the pair is an inheritance edge (Torah → Writings) of exactly the class the edge layer records.
ונח בן שש מאות שנה ("and Noah was six hundred years old") — שש with its own accent and NO maqqef (joining hyphen): Noah's age stands unjoined. SNAPSHOT: no maqqef after שש.

בשנת שש מאות שנה ("in the six-hundredth year," the date formula) — here שש WITH maqqef and no lengthening mark: the same number, joined when it dates the flood and free when it ages the man — Minchat Shai notes both pointings five verses apart. SNAPSHOT: maqqef after שש.
בחדש השני ("in the second month") — zaqef qatan ("small upright" pause accent) on the nun. SNAPSHOT agrees.
ויהי הגשם על הארץ ("and the rain was upon the earth") — על joined by maqqef (joining hyphen). SNAPSHOT agrees.
